scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run web:build
scripts.lint: npm run web:lint && npm run lint --workspace=@kartiseret/contracts
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace=kartiseret-web && prettier --config "Codebase - Kartiseret Web/package.json" --ignore-path .gitignore --check "packages/contracts/src/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}"
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=kartiseret-web && prettier --config "Codebase - Kartiseret Web/package.json" --ignore-path .gitignore --write "packages/contracts/src/**/*.{js,jsx,cjs,mjs,ts,tsx,cts,mts}"
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:build && npm run contracts:typecheck && npm run web:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run contracts:build && npm run web:test
scripts.verify: npm run contracts:build && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run contracts:typecheck && npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:test && npm run web:build && npm run bundle:check
